name: Hazor
brief: Major Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
short: Hazor was a major Canaanite city, whose king Jabin led a coalition against Israel; it was captured and destroyed by Joshua (<ref="Josh 11:1,10-11,13">Josh 11:1,10-11,13</ref>), later oppressing Israel before being defeated by Deborah and Barak (<ref="Judg 4:2">Judg 4:2,17</ref>).
